turns.q: Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.
turns.replyTail:
full-body coverage.

Quick comparison:

Coverage: 1000W is full body, 600W is half body
Size and weight: 1000W is larger and heavier, 600W is easier to fit into smaller spaces
Output: 1000W is stronger overall and better for broader sessions
Running draw: 1000W uses 300W actual consumption, 600W uses 180W
Best fit: 1000W if you want the best long-term all-rounder, 600W if you want to spend less but still avoid the handheld
If you want the safest middle choice, go with the HELIOS 1000W.
